meta.description: Fictional message and email activity log for a dashboard prototype. Includes personal conversations across messaging apps and a varied email inbox with account alerts, receipts, order updates, newsletters and promotions.
meta.note: Synthetic demo data. Names, message bodies, email content and sender details are illustrative and are not actual correspondence. Email sender addresses are sample-style addresses for UI prototyping.
